Title: Add CUDA build version selector (12.4 vs 13.3) to installer Native backend page
Description: The installer always uses CUDA 12.4. Users with CUDA 13.x drivers (R580+) may want to choose 13.3. Add a radio button pair on the BackendPage Native description area: CUDA 12.4 (recommended, broader driver support) / CUDA 13.3 (newest NVIDIA drivers). Pass chosen version as -CudaBuild to GetLlamaCppSetupArgs.
